title: Bind observations and record feedback
scenario: Scenario: task-feedback / workflow-map. Screenshots captured 2026-10-18 on a candidate based on main 48b854b. Text corrected after PR33 review. Use Python 3.11+ and a disposable home. Captures remain historical; current guidance below supersedes earlier cleanup wording.

steps.title: Find the task commands
steps.instruction: Open docs/map/workflow.html. Under Self-improvement and eval, open Private observations and expand its details. Follow Sources to account/observation/README.md for the command contract.
steps.caption: Historical actual map dialog. Command navigation remains applicable. Its older expiry/purge wording is superseded: expiry disables access immediately; prune performs physical deletion.
steps.expected: Bind exact events or an inclusive receipt range. Stored rows must fit 128 KiB after encoding; larger resolved rows are refused. feedback-add accepts an omitted/null revision or a valid existing revision token.

steps.title: Select, review and revoke
steps.instruction: Grant a disposable synthetic project and import events from two sessions. Bind only the intended events, repeat the request to check idempotency, then add feedback and inspect task-show. Reject unselected evidence. Revoke the grant when finished.
steps.caption: Historical browser summary of an actual synthetic CLI run, not a terminal capture. Separate post-review CLI checks verified corrupt/symlink cleanup and malformed revision refusal.
steps.expected: Retry is stable; unselected evidence is rejected. Revoke purges private tasks and feedback. Expiry requires prune for physical deletion. Corrupt unknown-lineage tasks are removed without following symlinks; valid unrelated tasks remain.
